label: Individual SVG icons

accessibility.rule: Icons without label default to aria-hidden=true and focusable=false.
Icons with label default to role=img and aria-label. Label icon-only buttons on the button and leave the icon decorative.

notes: All named icon components and SvgIconProps are exported only from @idenflu/ui-react/icons; the SvgIcon implementation is internal.
Numeric size controls width and height in pixels. Native SVG attributes, styles, className and SVG refs are forwarded. children, dangerouslySetInnerHTML, name and spriteHref are not public props.
Drawings are generated from packages/icons/src/icons.svg. No sprite URL, provider or stylesheet is needed. Color inherits currentColor.
Existing sprite-based Icon keeps its separate API.
